sections.title: Paediatrics (Pervez Akbar Khan, Basis of Pediatrics 10th ed.)
chapters: History taking and physical examination (incl. neonatal reflexes)
Growth and development (milestones, red flags, puberty and Tanner stages, growth charts)
Immunization (EPI schedule, each vaccine, cold chain, contraindications)
Social and preventive paediatrics (Pakistan statistics, child rights, abuse, neglect, child labour, IMCI)
Behavioural and psychiatric disorders (enuresis, encopresis, ADHD, autism, pica, tics, eating disorders)
Paediatric nutrition and nutritional disorders (breastfeeding, weaning, vitamins, minerals, malnutrition, obesity)
Fluid and electrolyte disorders (dehydration, sodium, potassium, acid-base)
Acutely ill child (anaphylaxis, shock, burns, foreign body, drowning, head trauma)
Neonatology 1: newborn care, prematurity, birth asphyxia, neonatal resuscitation, respiratory distress (RDS, MAS, TTN), apnoea, NEC, IVH, birth injuries
Neonatology 2: neonatal sepsis, TORCH and congenital infections, neonatal jaundice, neonatal conjunctivitis
Neonatology 3: neonatal hypoglycaemia, hypocalcaemia, infant of diabetic mother, SGA/LGA/post-term, neonatal seizures, haemorrhagic disease, neonatal anaemia and polycythaemia
Infectious diseases 1: diarrhoea, cholera, dysentery, giardiasis, amoebiasis, typhoid, worm infestations
Infectious diseases 2: polio, diphtheria, pertussis, tetanus, measles, mumps, varicella, malaria, tuberculosis, rheumatic fever, dengue, leishmaniasis, rabies, HIV in children
Respiratory disorders (croup, epiglottitis, bronchiolitis, pneumonia, asthma, cystic fibrosis, foreign body, pleural disease)
Gastrointestinal and liver disorders (GERD, chronic diarrhoea, coeliac, IBD, hepatitis, liver failure, cirrhosis, pancreatitis)
Cardiovascular disorders (congenital heart disease, heart failure, endocarditis, myocarditis, arrhythmias, Kawasaki)
Neurologic disorders (meningitis, encephalitis, seizures and epilepsy, headache, hydrocephalus, cerebral palsy, neurocutaneous syndromes)
Neuromuscular disorders (Duchenne, myasthenia, floppy infant, SMA, GBS, Bell palsy)
Haematologic disorders (anaemias, thalassaemia, sickle cell, aplastic anaemia, bleeding disorders, ITP, transfusion)
Neoplastic diseases (leukaemia, lymphoma, solid tumours, histiocytosis, lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly)
Endocrine disorders and rickets (growth hormone, thyroid, adrenal, diabetes mellitus, DKA, diabetes insipidus, rickets, puberty disorders)
Metabolic diseases (inborn errors of metabolism, glycogen storage, mucopolysaccharidoses, lysosomal)
Genetics and syndromes (chromosomal disorders, Down, Turner, inheritance patterns, named syndromes)
Nephrology and urinary tract (nephrotic and nephritic syndromes, UTI, AKI, CKD, hypertension, tubular disorders, HUS, HSP)
Paediatric surgery (cleft, atresias, intussusception, Hirschsprung, hernia, undescended testis, neural tube defects)
Bone, joint and rheumatology (septic arthritis, osteomyelitis, DDH, JIA, SLE, skeletal dysplasias, Marfan)
Other paediatric topics not in the contents list or miscellaneous (ethics, statistics, general medicine, junk rows)

notes: Routing rules: 1) Neonatal topics: P9 (resuscitation, asphyxia, prematurity, RDS, MAS, TTN, NEC, IVH, apnoea, birth trauma), P10 (sepsis, TORCH, jaundice, conjunctivitis), P11 (hypoglycaemia, IDM, SGA/LGA, seizures, HDN/vitamin K bleeding, polycythaemia). 2) Vaccine schedule and each vaccine -> P3 even when the disease is also in P13; the disease itself (clinical features, complications, treatment) -> P12 or P13. 3) Diarrhoea and WHO dehydration plans -> P12; sodium/potassium/acid-base disturbances -> P7. 4) Malnutrition, vitamins, breastfeeding -> P6; rickets -> P22. 5) Kawasaki -> P16; rheumatic fever -> P13 unless the question is about carditis or valvular disease -> P16. 6) Nephrotic/nephritic, HUS, HSP, UTI, hypertension -> P25. 7) JIA, SLE, dermatomyositis -> P29. 8) Febrile convulsions, epilepsy, meningitis -> P17; cerebral malaria -> P13. 9) Congenital cardiac lesions -> P16. 10) Anaemias incl. thalassaemia and sickle cell -> P19; childhood cancers -> P20. 11) Down syndrome, Turner, chromosomal disorders -> P24; congenital hypothyroidism and CAH -> P22. 12) Poisonings -> P28. 13) Intussusception, pyloric stenosis, Hirschsprung, atresias -> P27. 14) IMCI classification and child rights -> P4. 15) Use PX only if nothing fits.
